...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Neches River at Neches River Saltwater Barrier affecting Jasper,
Orange, Jefferson and Hardin Counties.

Village Creek Near Kountze affecting Hardin County.

Pine Island Bayou Near Sour Lake affecting Jefferson and Hardin
Counties.

Saltwater Barrier...Minor flooding is forecast.
For the Village Creek...including Kountze...Minor flooding is
forecast.
For the Pine Island Bayou...including Sour Lake...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Village Creek near Kountze.

* WHEN...Until Sunday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 20.0 feet, Water begins to flow over the bridge on
Farm to Market Road 418. Water also begins to cover F.M. 418 at
several other locations. Road in Village Creek State Park begins to
have water across it.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:30 AM CDT Saturday the stage was 20.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 9:30 AM CDT Saturday was 21.8 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage late
tomorrow morning and continue falling to 6.8 feet Thursday
morning.
- Flood stage is 17.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 20.8
feet on 01/09/1998.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.description:
SVRFFC

The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Western DeKalb County in north central Georgia...
Northern Clayton County in north central Georgia...
South central Fulton County in north central Georgia...

* Until 730 PM EDT.

* At 644 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Virginia
Highland, or near Atlanta, moving south at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Atlanta, Decatur, City of South Fulton, Sandy Springs, Dunwoody,
East Point, Union City, Forest Park, Riverdale, College Park,
Chamblee, Doraville, Clarkston, Morrow, Hapeville, Avondale
Estates, Lake City, Pine Lake, North Decatur, and North Atlanta.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

If you see wind damage...hail or flooding...wait until the storm has
passed...and then call the National Weather Service toll free
at 1 8 6 6 7 6 3 4 4 6 6 or tweet us your report at NWSATLANTA.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 5 at 6:56PM EDT until September 5 at 7:45PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
properties.description:
For the following areas...
Pamlico Sound...

At 656 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located near The Center Of
The Pamlico Sound, or 8 nm south of Engelhard, moving east at 10
knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

Locations impacted include...
Pamlico Sound, Engelhard, and The Center Of The Pamlico Sound.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with this storm. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 5 at 6:20PM EDT until September 5 at 7:45PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
SMWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 0-20 nm...
Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm...
Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 20-60 nm...

* Until 745 PM EDT.

* At 620 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located over Melbourne,
moving southeast at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, lightning and heavy downpours. Make sure all on
board are wearing life jackets. Return to safe harbor if
possible.

* Locations impacted include...
Melbourne Beach, Melbourne, Indialantic, Spessard Holland Park, and
Eau Gallie.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 5 at 6:46PM EDT until September 5 at 8:15PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
properties.description:
SMWMHX

The National Weather Service in Newport has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
S of Cape Lookout NC to Surf City NC out to 20 NM...
Waters from Cape Lookout  to Surf City NC from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 815 PM EDT.

* At 646 PM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 9 nm west of The Vicinity Of Highway 24-17 Bridge to
near New River Inlet to Ar342, moving south at 20 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to nearly 50 knots and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
The Center Of Bogue Sound, Salter Path, Ar342, Ar320, Bogue Inlet,
The Vicinity Of Highway 24-
17 Bridge, Ar355, The Vicinity Of Emerald Isle Bridge, Ar345,
Emerald Isle, Morgan Bay, New River Inlet, Ar340, Ar330, Stones
Bay, and The Vicinity Of Sneads Ferry Bridge.
properties.instruction:
Boaters should seek safe harbor immediately until these storms pass.
Wind gusts to nearly 50 knots, small hail, high waves, dangerous
lightning, and heavy rain are possible with these storms.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 5 at 6:42PM EDT until September 5 at 9:45PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
properties.description:
FFWMHX

The National Weather Service in Newport/Morehead City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southwestern Carteret County in eastern North Carolina...

* Until 945 PM EDT.

* At 642 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Morehead City, Cape Carteret, Broad Creek, Bogue, Bogue Inlet Pier
and Cedar Point.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.
